lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bhaanaa bhaavai so tujhahi samaae ||
lines.translation: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhaane vich vadee vadiaaee bhaanaa kisahi karaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa guroo milaae ||
lines.translation: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath paae ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aapanai bhaanai sabh srisat upaaee jis no bhaanaa dehi tis bhaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh kare chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanaa na ma(n)ne bahut dukh paaee ||
lines.translation: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ghar mahal na kabahoo paaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mele de vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa dhur phuramaaee ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve taa naam paae naame hee sukh paaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh naavahu upajai naavahu chheejai ||
lines.translation: Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan bheejai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa naam dhiaae ras bheejai ras hee te ras paaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalai a(n)dar mahal ko paae ||
lines.translation: Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion of their own body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sach chit laae ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis no sach dei soee sach paae sache sach milaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and only Truth. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam visaar man tan dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh rog kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai man tan hai kusatee narake vaasaa paaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate tin niramal dehaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal ha(n)saa sadaa sukh nehaa ||
lines.translation: Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam salaahi sadaa sukh paaiaa nij ghar vaasaa paaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own inner being. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko vanaj kare vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: Everyone deals and trades.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh totaa sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all the world loses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naago aaiaa naago jaasee vin naavai dukh paaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no naam dei so paae ||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavai no lochai jetee sabh aaee ||
lines.translation: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau tinaa milai dhur purab kamaaee ||
lines.translation: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by the Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naau paaiaa se vadabhaagee gur kai sabad milaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are united with God. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kot at apaaraa ||
lines.translation: Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich bahi prabh kare veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Within it, God sits in contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa niaau sacho vaapaaraa nihachal vaasaa paaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal, unchanging dwelling. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਘਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar ghar ba(n)ke thaan suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai thaan paaiaa ||
lines.translation: But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: it saath nibahai saalaahe sache har sachaa ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai karatai ik banat banaaee ||
lines.translation: My Creator Lord has formed this formation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is dehee vich sabh vath paaee ||
lines.translation: He has placed everything within this body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vanajahi ra(n)g raate guramukh ko naam paaidaa ||16||6||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ka(n)chan sabad veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tithai har vasai jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har sevihu sachee baanee har jeeu sabad milaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1||
